answer: I would stake my own seat on Hop grower malt bin proof brewed at the cellar, because its proof, each malt bin is a season of logged brew readings plus a signed brew record, is public and checkable. Trust is priced per proof: 203 POA each, and the farm's 593 proofs tie up 120379 POA it will never see again if it cheats.
